name: 12946 · Lake Placid, NY
findings: ZIP 12946 (Lake Placid) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12946 (Lake Placid) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12946 (Lake Placid) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
